From Talking Head · Price: your stand must touch the target's tongue (an open mouth, a bite).

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 2 actions: curse a creature to lie: everything it says is a lie (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).
  • 5: Surge: a cursed creature can't use actions with the linguistic trait for 1 round.
  • 9: The curse lasts 1 hour.
  • 13: You know the truth of what it says.
  • 17: The curse lasts 1 day.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
